title: Acacia as the Tree of Life in Egypt, Freemasonry and the Ark of the Covenant

tellings.quote: life or the the acacia tree being the Tree of Life in Egypt and then in Freemasonry The Acacia Leaf is is a big is a kind of place prominent it plays a role in Freemasonry and um there's there's no doubt about it the wood out of which the Ark of the Covenant was made was acacia wood

plain: Michels says the acacia tree was the Tree of Life in ancient Egypt, that the acacia leaf plays a prominent role in Freemasonry, and that "there's no doubt about it" the Ark of the Covenant was made of acacia wood. He raises it in conversation with Graham Hancock, a writer on lost ancient civilizations, and credits him. The thread he draws suggests one sacred symbol carried from Egypt into the Bible and later secret societies.
